summary: Products, Benchmarks, the Finder and five OEM guides now share one ChipIndex header, version and release history. OEM guides sit within Platforms with shared platform tools, lesson navigation and routes back to the Finder. Fresh responsive and interaction checks passed; protected catalog facts and reviewed drawings remain unchanged.
strengths: Public beta 0.0.5 and What's new remain visible on all eight main pages; six releases are retained in the shared history.
OEM navigation belongs to Platforms rather than replacing a global header control. Guides retain their learning structure, brand accents and server artwork.
All 102 profile cards across five OEM lineups fit at desktop and mobile widths, with prominent processor, DIMM and DPC information.
Existing Finder comparison, OEM model deep links and model dialogs continue to work with the new layout.
Automated preservation guards and deterministic generation protect the catalog, artwork and shared presentation assets.
limitations: This review covers interface integration. The earlier specification and physical-reference reviews retain their own recorded scope and dates.
HPE ProLiant XD245/XD285 and Supermicro SBA-817V7-1N remain explicitly labeled contextual schematics.
Coverage is curated and partial; exact configuration and orderability require OEM confirmation. HPE QuickSpecs remain primary HPE configuration evidence.
Public publication and hosted validation remain separate owner actions.

upstream.scope: The prior browser results apply to the separate v1.2 source release. They are retained in the build inputs and are not evidence of this integrated interface.
